notes.blacklist_meaning: Brands on this list are blocked from the universal sourcing filter regardless of category. The list is Cron-re-checked monthly against live gating status via the Amazon Selling Partner API (tasks/brand_blacklist_updater.py); brands that become un-gated are surfaced for operator decision, never auto-removed.
notes.whitelist_meaning: Brands explicitly allowed even when the seller-identity gate would otherwise flag them. Reserved for operator decisions.
notes.static_exclusions: The separate static store/private-label exclusion list (Kirkland Signature, Member's Mark, Great Value, Equate, store brand, private label) lives in filters/universal_filter.py and category_config.py and always applies.
